content: Supabase RLS role-based patterns: enable RLS on profiles; policy 'select own profile' using auth.uid() = id; separate policy for privileged roles to select all profiles. IMPORTANT pitfall: a policy on table A that queries a second RLS-protected table (e.g. profiles) to check the caller's role can cause infinite recursion, especially if profiles' own policy also queries profiles. Fix: wrap the role check in a SECURITY DEFINER function (LANGUAGE plpgsql, not sql -- plpgsql avoids query-planner inlining that would silently drop the SECURITY DEFINER bypass) and call that function from policies instead of inlining the subquery. Alternative: put role in the JWT (app_metadata) to avoid a table lookup entirely, at the cost of the JWT staying stale until re-login/refresh.
